title: Badge count stays after logout
body:
Steps: log in, get a few notifications so the badge shows 3, log out, log in as someone else.

The badge still shows 3 for the new user. `logout()` in `src/auth/session.ts` clears the session but never touches the badge.
author: maintainer

title: Toasts overlap when two fire together
body:
Save a draft while offline. The "saved locally" toast and the "you are offline" toast are drawn on top of each other in the bottom right corner, so only one can be read.

Seen on a phone and on a laptop.
author: maintainer

title: Countdown shows 1:5 instead of 1:05
body:
With 65 seconds left the countdown label reads `1:5`. It should read `1:05`.

`countdownLabel` in `src/timer/countdown.ts` builds the string by hand.
author: maintainer

title: Last page of results is empty
body:
A list of exactly 20 items at 10 per page: jumping to the last page shows nothing. With 21 items the last page is fine.

Looks like the page count is one too high when the total divides evenly. See `src/list/paginate.ts`.
author: maintainer

title: Pager shows one page too many
body: 30 items, 10 per page. The pager draws `[1] [2] [3] [4]`. There are only three pages of items; the fourth button leads to an empty page.
author: maintainer

title: Timer displays seconds without zero padding
body: The timer on the session screen shows `2:7` when there are two minutes and seven seconds left. Seconds below ten need a leading zero.
author: maintainer

title: CI caches the wrong directory
body: The cache step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` saves `~/.cache/yarn`, but the project installs with pnpm, so every run starts from a cold store. It should cache the pnpm store path.
author: maintainer

title: Crisis phrase matcher misses curly apostrophes
body: Phones type a curly apostrophe. `i can’t go on` (curly) does not match the phrase list in `src/crisis/keywords.ts`, which only has the straight form, so the message is not flagged.
author: maintainer

title: Add a dark theme option
body: Several people have asked for a dark theme. Should we follow the system setting, add a toggle in settings, or both? And do we want the brand colours to change in dark mode or stay as they are?
author: maintainer

title: App feels slow sometimes
body: It was laggy this morning. Not sure what I was doing. Can someone look?
author: someuser

title: Search box loses focus after every keystroke
body:
Type one letter in the search box and the cursor leaves the field. You have to click back in for every letter.

title: clamp returns NaN for empty input
body: Passing the value of an empty number field to `clamp` gives `NaN` back and the slider jumps to the far left edge and then breaks. `src/lib/clamp.ts` should treat an empty value as the minimum.
author: maintainer
